caption: Our test video in the KillerPlayer player on the free plan: no YouTube title, logo or channel name, only KillerPlayer's own controls.
After the video ended, the player went back to its own play button instead of showing suggested YouTube videos.
The Video Library after the test: 1 of 5 videos and 1 of 500 monthly views used on the free plan.
Domain lock under General settings is a Premium feature on the free plan, with Buy Addon and Upgrade plan buttons.
Yearly prices on 22 Nov 2026: Starter $2, Plus $4, Premium $6 and Enterprise $8 a month for the first year.
